item.title: Earthquake of magnitude 6.6 strikes near coast of Central Chile, GFZ says
item.description: A magnitude 6.6 earthquake struck Central Chile on Thursday, the German Research Center for Geosciences(GFZ)said. The quake was at a depth of 10 km (6.21 miles), GFZ said. (Reuters)
